tool_input.command:
mkdir -p forgemyspec-bundle/time-tracker && cat > forgemyspec-board.yaml <<'E'
- id: R1
  status: doing
  title: "Time tracker CLI"
  quote: "Build a time tracker CLI in Python. Subcommands: start <project>, stop, log, report. Persist sessions in a JSON file, refuse to start a session while another is active, detect overlapping sessions, show durations formatted as HH:MM:SS, and report total time per project. Single file time_tracker.py, stdlib only."
  steps:
    - {do: "Write and lint spec", check: "cmd: PYTHONPATH=.forgemyspec/harness python3 -m forgemyspec lint forgemyspec-bundle/time-tracker/spec.yaml --formal"}
    - {do: "User approves spec bundle", ok: false}
    - {do: "Implement time_tracker.py and tests, gate passes", ok: false}
  next: "user approval of the spec"
E
cat > forgemyspec-bundle/time-tracker/spec.yaml <<'E'
version: "0.1"
title: Time tracker CLI
objective: A single-file, stdlib-only Python CLI (time_tracker.py) that tracks work sessions per project in a JSON file.
execution_mode: critical
context:
  system: Empty Python repository; run with python3 time_tracker.py; tests with unittest in tests/.
  assumptions:
    - "The data file path defaults to ~/.time_tracker.json and can be overridden with the --file option or TIME_TRACKER_FILE env var."
    - "Timestamps are stored as ISO 8601 local-naive strings with seconds precision."
    - "Overlap means two sessions whose intervals intersect with positive length; an active session counts as ending now."
    - "Overlaps are detected and reported as warnings in log and report; they are not deleted or merged."
    - "report counts each project's total as the sum of its session durations, active session included up to now."
constraints:
  - Single file time_tracker.py with Python standard library only.
  - No third-party packages, no database, no network.
  - No edit, delete or manual-add subcommands.
success_criteria:
  - All boundary tests in tests/ pass.
  - Starting while a session is active exits non-zero and leaves the file unchanged.
hypotheses:
  - {id: h1, description: "start <project> records a new active session in the JSON file and stop closes it, with sessions surviving across invocations.", confidence: 0.9}
  - {id: h2, description: "start while another session is active exits with code 1 and does not modify the file.", confidence: 0.9}
  - {id: h3, description: "log lists sessions with durations formatted HH:MM:SS and flags overlapping sessions.", confidence: 0.85}
  - {id: h4, description: "report prints total time per project formatted HH:MM:SS.", confidence: 0.9}
required_evidence:
  - "unittest run of tests/ with all tests passing"
  - "gate output ending in RESULT: PASS"
actions:
  - {id: a1, description: "Implement time_tracker.py with start, stop, log, report", type: implement, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h1, h2, h3, h4]}
  - {id: a2, description: "Write boundary tests in tests/test_time_tracker.py", type: implement, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h1, h2, h3, h4]}
  - {id: a3, description: "Run the gate and review the output", type: validate, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h1, h2, h3, h4]}
decision_rules:
  - "If a requirement is ambiguous, stop and ask the user."
  - "Any behavior beyond the obligations is a spec amendment."
metadata:
  source_prompt: "Build a time tracker CLI in Python. Subcommands: start <project>, stop, log, report. Persist sessions in a JSON file, refuse to start a session while another is active, detect overlapping sessions, show durations formatted as HH:MM:SS, and report total time per project. Single file time_tracker.py, stdlib only."
  generator: claude-code-session
  scope_contract:
    must_include:
      - "sessions persisted in JSON file"
      - "start refused while another session is active"
      - "overlapping sessions detected"
      - "durations formatted HH:MM:SS"
      - "total time per project"
      - "single file time_tracker.py, stdlib only"
formal:
  module: TimeTracker
  obligations:
    - id: persist_sessions
      kind: boundary
      statement: "start then stop writes a session to the JSON file that a later invocation reads back."
      hypotheses: [h1]
      must_include: ["sessions persisted in JSON file"]
      test: "test_time_tracker.TrackerTests.test_start_stop_persists"
    - id: start_refused_when_active
      kind: boundary
      statement: "start while a session is active exits 1 and leaves the file byte-identical."
      hypotheses: [h2]
      must_include: ["start refused while another session is active"]
      test: "test_time_tracker.TrackerTests.test_start_refused_when_active"
    - id: overlap_detected
      kind: boundary
      statement: "log flags sessions whose intervals intersect."
      hypotheses: [h3]
      must_include: ["overlapping sessions detected"]
      test: "test_time_tracker.TrackerTests.test_overlap_detected"
    - id: duration_format
      kind: boundary
      statement: "Durations render as zero-padded HH:MM:SS, hours may exceed 99."
      hypotheses: [h3, h4]
      must_include: ["durations formatted HH:MM:SS"]
      test: "test_time_tracker.TrackerTests.test_duration_format"
    - id: report_totals
      kind: boundary
      statement: "report prints the summed duration per project."
      hypotheses: [h4]
      must_include: ["total time per project"]
      test: "test_time_tracker.TrackerTests.test_report_totals"
    - id: single_file_stdlib
      kind: boundary
      statement: "time_tracker.py imports only standard library modules."
      hypotheses: [h1]
      must_include: ["single file time_tracker.py, stdlib only"]
      test: "test_time_tracker.TrackerTests.test_stdlib_only"
scope:
  paths: ["time_tracker.py", "tests/**"]
  tests: tests
  pythonpath: ["."]
E
export PYTHONPATH=.forgemyspec/harness
python3 -m forgemyspec lint forgemyspec-bundle/time-tracker/spec.yaml --formal && python3 -m forgemyspec package forgemyspec-bundle/time-tracker/spec.yaml

**What the spec covers** (`forgemyspec-bundle/time-tracker/spec.yaml`). All six obligations are tested at the boundary with unittest. Nothing is proven in Dafny, since nothing here is critical logic.

| id | statement |
|---|---|

| start_refused_when_active | start while a session is active exits 1 and leaves the file unchanged |
| overlap_detected | log flags sessions whose intervals intersect |
| duration_format | durations are zero-padded HH:MM:SS, and hours can exceed 99 |
| report_totals | report prints the summed duration per project |
| single_file_stdlib | `time_tracker.py` imports only standard library modules |

**Assumptions I made. Please check them.**
- The data file defaults to `~/.time_tracker.json`. You can override it with `--file` or the `TIME_TRACKER_FILE` environment variable.
- Timestamps are stored as local ISO 8601 strings with seconds precision.
- Overlap means two sessions share a stretch of positive length, and an active session counts as ending now.
- Overlaps are shown as warnings in `log` and `report`. Nothing is deleted or merged.
- A project's total in `report` includes the active session up to now.
- There are no edit, delete or manual-add subcommands.
